# OCI API Gateway

### Known gaps

- Gateways report no ipAddresses and the IPv4/IPv6 address configuration objects are ignored; the subnet is only checked for existence (public gateways are not required to sit in a public subnet).
- Unverified, chosen by the emulator: route precedence between overlapping paths, trailing-slash handling, 405 with Allow for a method mismatch, the 200 status of CORS preflight answers, the data plane error body shape, Retry-After on 429, 400 for failed request validations (Oracle says only 4xx), 401/403 for missing, unknown or unentitled usage-plan tokens, 401 for a mutualTls SAN mismatch, the 409 for operations on a locked resource, 404 for removing an absent lock, default HTTP backend timeouts (60 s connect, 10 s read, 10 s send, applied as one overall deadline), the order filter then rename then set for transformations, isRequired defaulting to true for verifyClaims, JWT tokenHeader defaulting to Authorization with scheme Bearer, a missing optional claim passing, the Monday start of WEEK quota windows.
- Unverified, from memory: the CUSTOM_AUTHENTICATION function request/response contract (TOKEN and USER_DEFINED payloads, active/scope/wwwAuthenticate fields), 502 for a failing function, that tokenHeader values are passed to the authorizer without the scheme, the OpenAPI-derived Api fields (specificationType text, validation check names), the SDK language catalog and the WR operation names of the APIs, SDKs, usage plan and subscriber families.
- CORS allowedOrigins match '*' or the exact origin string; Oracle's wildcard hostnames in origins are not expanded. Routes of one deployment share the deployment CORS policy unless they carry their own.
- TLS is served on the shared emulator port, not on 443: deployment endpoints use the https://<hostname> form that does not resolve locally (clients must connect to the emulator port with SNI set to the gateway hostname), HTTP/2 is not offered, a gateway without a certificate cannot be reached over TLS, and PRIVATE gateways are served exactly like PUBLIC ones.
- OCI Certificates is not emulated: CA bundle PEMs are registered through the emulator-only /_gopherstack/oci/apigateway/ca-bundles endpoint. The mTLS chain-depth rule counts CA certificates only; the 'no default CA bundle' rule is implicit because only registered bundles are trusted.
- The external response cache server is never contacted (in-process cache instead), cache server outage and timeouts are not emulated, and cache entries and usage-plan counters are in memory only (not persisted, per process).
- SDK resources are stored only: no client library is generated, so artifactUrl is never set. The Api resource never reaches FAILED for semantically bad content (validations report it instead).
- OAuth2 login/logout backends, REMOTE_DISCOVERY with VALIDATION_BLOCK client or source details, body validationType other than NONE and JSON-schema body validation are rejected with 400; access and execution log policies are stored but nothing is written to OCI Logging.
- Cancelling a work request marks it CANCELED but does not stop the resource transition it describes.
- No separate connect/send timeout enforcement, no retries, no streaming flush; request bodies are buffered up to 10 MiB.
- opc-retry-token idempotency, IAM policy checks, resource principals and instance principals are not applied; only API-key signatures are verified. Tag values are stored verbatim and systemTags are never set.
- The dashboard has no OCI API Gateway page.
